test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT/CLT are optional for all applicants, including international. Scores are required to be considered for the Regents Scholars Program merit scholarships. SAT or ACT is required for home-schooled applicants.

requirements.supplemental_essays: Common App personal essay plus one Pepperdine essay (300-500 words) on why you are interested in a Christian university and how you would contribute to conversations of faith on campus.
requirements.notes: One academic letter of recommendation from a core-subject teacher or counselor (the page says teacher or counselor). Sixth-semester (through grade 11) transcript required at application. Fee waiver for financial need per CDS C13. Nursing applicants must apply Regular Decision (deadlines page).

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Page lists month/day only (no year); year inferred from the current 2026 page that references Fall 2027 applicants. Admitted ED students are stated to receive at least $25,000 in merit aid. The international applicant page lists only EA and RD, not ED.
The international applicant page (older text) says EA decisions are sent January 10.
The international applicant page says RD decisions are sent April 1.

deadlines.label: FAFSA deadline - Early Action / Early Decision I
Enrollment deadline - Early Action and Regular Decision

english_policy.waiver_notes: International first-years must show English proficiency by one of: SAT EBRW 600+, ACT Reading 24+, TOEFL iBT 85+, Cambridge C1/C2 186+, Duolingo 120+, LanguageCert Academic 70+, IELTS 6.5+, a B or better in a US college English Composition course, C or better in A-Level/AS English, IB English 5+, or 4 years at a high school taught in English (verified by a counselor). Scores must be within 2 years of application. TOEFL MyBest scores not accepted.

english.notes: iBT or Home Edition; MyBest scores not accepted.
Overall score; IELTS Indicator also accepted.

aid.notes: CDS H6 (2025-26): only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents (145 recipients, average $36,013). All applicants are automatically considered for the George Pepperdine Achievement Award; no separate application. Regents Scholars Program needs SAT/ACT/CLT scores.

ielts.note: No numeric code; the page says to send IELTS to 'Pepperdine Seaver College'.

duolingo.note: No code or recipient name published on the admissions pages checked.

pte.note: PTE is not listed among Pepperdine's accepted English proficiency options.

tier_notes.nursing: BSN started in fall 2025 (California BRN approval May 2025); national accreditation still pending.
